senses.example: El lunes tengo clase de español.
senses.exampleGloss: On Monday I have Spanish class.

alternatives.reason: Plural form for a weekly habit: los lunes hago la compra.
Contrasts with el fin de semana; the day names stay the same.

notes: Days of the week are lower-case in Spanish and masculine: el lunes, los lunes. The plural is unchanged.
